kypExtensions.summary: The two-dial decoder and the four-move reading protocol for any correlation: the SIGN is the slope (positive r value -> positive correlation, as one variable ↑ the other variable ↑; negative r value -> negative correlation, as one variable ↑ the other ↓) and the SIZE is the snugness (the closer |r| is to 1, the stronger the linear correlation) — two INDEPENDENT dials (the sign never adds strength: -0.8 is stronger than +0.4) — sequenced as SIGN -> SIZE -> SQUARE -> VERDICT, with the range check (r lives in [-1, +1], r² in [0, 1]) and the reverse move (given r², the correlation is ±sqrt, sign from the scatter's slope).
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the sentences as parallel facts; the dial separation, the independence of sign and strength, the ordered protocol, and the reverse-squaring move are KYP's synthesis.
kypExtensions.location: core.keyIdea + mechanisms[0] scatter-to-r-map + blocks[3] the steps block + the visual's Zone B SIGN and SIZE cards and Zone A rule strip

kypExtensions.summary: The variance-pricing layer for r²: the coefficient of determination read as the proportion of variance in one variable explained by variance in the other — the worked arithmetic (r = ±0.8 -> r² = 0.64 -> 64% explained, 36% not; r = ±0.4 -> 0.16 -> 16%; halving r quarters the explained variance) — plus the literature habit (papers quote r and let the reader square it) and the exam rule ('proportion of variance explained' routes to r², never r).
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the formula sentence only; the worked percentages, the 2x-vs-4x asymmetry, the journal-club framing, and the routing rule are KYP's.
kypExtensions.location: mechanisms[1] r-squared-variance-map + blocks[2] the gallery decoder + blocks[4] the r vs r² compare block + the visual's Zone B SQUARE card and per-panel r² chips

kypExtensions.summary: The five-panel gallery read as a calibration ladder: the printed order (-0.8 strong negative -> -0.4 weak negative -> 0 no correlation -> +0.4 weak positive -> +0.8 strong positive) as a two-axis grid (direction x tightness), the geometry grammar (slope of the cloud sets the sign, spread around the line sets |r|, the fit-line arrow printed only in the two strong panels as the visual signature of strength, positives mirroring negatives), and the linear-only caveat keyed to the printed word 'linear' (r = 0 kills the straight line, not a curved relationship — a perfect U can still have r = 0).
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the five panels as artwork with labels; the ladder reading, the geometry grammar, the mirror symmetry as a strength lesson, and the r = 0 curvature caveat are KYP's interpretation.
kypExtensions.location: mechanisms[0] scatter-to-r-map + blocks[2] the gallery decoder list + the visual's Zone A five redrawn panels + usmle.traps[3] + mnemonics 'ZERO MEANS NO LINE, NOT NO LINK'
